scripts.features: Yo ise este script
scripts.script:
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Char = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Hum = Char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local HRP = Char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local speedSaved = 30
local potionTarget = Vector3.new(-68.18, 146.07, 91.34)
local tpwalkTarget = Vector3.new(-100, 146, 120) -- 🎯 Punto para TPWalk 1
local enabled = false
local tpwalkEnabled = false

-- UI
local menu = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
menu.Name = "DWMenu"
menu.ResetOnSpawn = false

local openBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", menu)
openBtn.Text = "📦"
openBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
openBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -20)
openBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.6, 1)
openBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
openBtn.TextScaled = true
openBtn.Draggable = true

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", menu)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 400)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0.5, -180)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
frame.Visible = false

openBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
end)

local function createBtn(text, posY)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, posY)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	return btn
end

-- Brillar
local fbBtn = createBtn("🔆 Brillar Todo", 5)
fbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local light = game:GetService("Lighting")
	light.Brightness = 5
	light.ClockTime = 14
	light.FogEnd = 100000
	light.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(1,1,1)
end)

-- Velocidad
local speedBtn = createBtn("⚡ Velocidad 30", 40)
speedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Hum.WalkSpeed = 30
	speedSaved = 30
end)

-- ESP
local function createESP(part, color)
	if part and not part:FindFirstChild("ESP") then
		local esp = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", part)
		esp.Name = "ESP"
		esp.Size = part.Size
		esp.Adornee = part
		esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
		esp.ZIndex = 10
		esp.Color3 = color
		esp.Transparency = 0.5
	end
end

local espBtn = createBtn("👁️ ESP Todo", 75)
espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Model") then
			local p = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
			local n = v.Name:lower()
			if p then
				if n:find("monster") or n:find("twist") then
					createESP(p, Color3.new(1,0,0))
